_comment: The augmentation section's defaults: what the attacks draw (adversarial, to jailbreaks.csv) and what the variations draw (natural, to variations.csv). A recipe's augmentations overlays them key by key (layers, families and techniques list by list); a kind given as null is off. An empty layer_rates is the spec's rates. The attacks never draw a family of natural_only_families unless their families.allow names it. translation alone decides the translation family, whatever the lists say: false keeps it out, true puts it in; flip it to true once a local translation model is registered. Read by jailbreak/augmentation.py.
